answer: Incident shape: a recruited identity fails an audit, so the vouch that recruited it burns. Record: reciprocal weights, inbound capped by outbound, recruiter exposure held until the recruit clears 3 epochs. Recruiter A vouches for B, B fails, A loses exactly the weight A gave and the vault entry closes. A thread of 200 recruits exposes 200 weights on one wallet. To farm, an operator accepts that exposure at every seat, and the cheapest path costs more than honest work because honest work never burns a vouch. A farm's zenith is one failed recruit away.
